一人血书让凤凰变成嚣张雌小鬼

距离第一次留下评价已经过去了数年的时间，距离上次将好评修改为差评也过去了数年的时间。在即将上线正式版以前，反过头来回顾一下这个游戏。 时至今日我依旧觉得这是一个设计精良，内容丰富的游戏。 尽管作者的更新速度不敢恭维，但是更新质量确实能算得上优秀。 随着很多上修更新和重做，之前提到的红卡之耻、装备之耻得到了非常大的修正，毫无疑问的，现在反过头来再玩，体验绝对比之前好很多。 但是即使如此，我依旧非常难以和这游戏推崇的机制怪和解，也依旧认为，即使是在时吞改动过之后，这玩意依旧是我这些年见过的最粪DBG游戏设计。 别的boss姑且也就是个比较复杂的解谜机制，最大的难点来自那个有时候写的很模糊的描述文本（至于是不是翻译的锅就不清楚了），需要你理解并“额外去做什么”来应对机制。时吞则是不讲道理的“你必须去接受什么”，没得选，机制一开始就吃满了。 各种以干扰为主的机制boss导致了，部分情况下，单回合3张卡打1000弱于单回合1张卡打600。在boss战的高压环境下，即使那几个和黑雾相关的遗物已经修改的非常实用了，长线作战依旧是性价比相当低的行为。 说真的，这游戏角色+遗物有那么多组合联动的可能性，结果到了不同的boss分出了明显的三六九等，对抗思路直接被降维打击压的扁平，属实难顶。 他哪怕boss房给个二选一，允许你绕过相性最差的boss或者进门直接看见boss是哪个，让你及时止损都是个好选择，然而至今还是啥优化没有。 以下是旧评论，我觉得有些内容搁几年后的现在还能对得上号，所以不删了 游戏本身的质量和完成度是值一个好评的，但是我还是选择了不推荐。 在我看来，这游戏犯了很多暴雪式的错误，作者太想把这游戏打造成有难度的样子，却导致游戏本身娱乐性严重缺失。 有太多boss是以破坏玩家构筑运转来提供挑战性，从禁疗到锁combo一样俱全 一些打桩能连打七八下的combo，遇见克制的boss甚至会卡住等死 DBG模式和肉鸽类游戏的核心都是逐渐提升自己，完成一个逐渐变强的过程 说的通俗点就是开局木剑平A，后期阎魔刀次元斩 但是这个游戏经常却通过各类破坏性机制去阻止你获得对应的体验，一但roll到克制boss，你的构筑有概率会直接崩盘。 单纯通关确实不难，但是想打点猴戏或者打个爽局，真的是究极困难。 这游戏提供了很多花活思路，然后又通过严苛的boss机制给你直接掐死，稳定性的单卡收益胜过一切，打combo变成了小丑的表演。 有句话叫“没用过扎师傅+伊芙去挑战钟表boss的人生是不圆满的”，很好笑是吧，呵呵。 同时，道具池、遗物池、技能池突出一个杂而不精，什么鬼东西都往里放，调换的成本又很高，各种红卡之耻、装备之耻、技能之耻层出不穷，越解锁这粪坑就越深。 我没法事先看到我要打的boss，没法根据boss临时大改构筑或者临时换人，甚至一局的时间要在2小时往上，结果你的BD是粪坑淘金，boss是随缘找爹，谁家肉鸽游戏都没有这么刷脸的。 总之，还是趁早开了创意工坊吧，做个mod直接把废装备、废技能还有粪boss统统ban掉，就皆大欢喜了。

各种设定一大堆玩着太难受了，比如上个debuff就分弱化干扰痛苦三种，要仔细看自己的装备技能到底是联动哪种减益。技能又分过载和迅速，用过载就要考虑怪的回合，还有搞不懂的倒计时技能，玩的脑壳都大了。 玩着没有明显的变强的感觉，一通操作猛如虎,定睛一看原地杵，打起来根本不知道怎么出伤害。看了全卡牌评测才知道每个角色牌就两种，稀有红牌和普通牌，关键稀有牌很多看起来也就一般，莫名其妙的特效。还有装备也是，紫装橙装一堆不知所谓，遗物也是莫名其妙的特效。 看了一局主播的最高难度录播，感觉就是只要不被打死，就能把怪慢慢磨死。通关时间普遍在两个小时左右。 玩尖塔暗黑地牢最高难度像是在度假，玩这个熟练难度就像是在坐牢了。就通关过几次，玩起来没什么正反馈，但是负反馈绝对爆炸，坐牢坐到一半，一个小时多了，一个操作失误了直接给送回家重来我是顶不住的。 每打完一关才能存档，而且必须手动存档，如果没存游戏关了，那之前玩的部分直接消失。 总的来说就是强度太高流程太长了，我还以为是我玩的少不熟练，结果主播来也要打两小时我真流汗了。 这游戏没有大把时间专门玩，没有随时自动存档机制，想休闲一下的是别想了。

好游戏碰上了你们的好员工（南风）引发的化学反应，唯一的新地图mod的制作者就因为你们员工的任性而离开了（一并下架了许多重要mod），这类游戏没mod寿命就极短，混元你这操作真的难绷，不想让mod社区好起来是吗？ 公司员工如果不想和你沟通就可以随时滥用用特权禁止你发言，而代价只是自己骂人得开个小号（真是好重的惩罚） 如果真的觉得mod不重要可以直接关闭接口，而不是抱怨mod制作者（但你又没有这个魄力，毕竟没mod更没销量） 此差评献给你们抽象员工南风（和幽默处罚————社区禁言）
不推荐，官方下场喷玩家本来就是大忌，更别说是优质mod作者了，直接赶走社区生态的一部分，而对涉事工作人员的处罚仅仅是禁言？乐。

总结为屎，除开音乐和美术一无是处的游戏，制作组十分傲慢和充满偏见，结晶多的要命 制作组对自己本体+DLC合计160的定价还非常有自信。 机制复杂，战斗信息饱和度高，我们在大量阅读理解和各种机制中找到了少量的数值。 喜欢我卡牌游戏全是强机制吗？转移buff，均分伤害，饱和控制，然后每回合给你一刀死门，喜欢我像暗黑地牢一样的满血斩杀线吗？ 每个BOSS都是阅读理解，有的效果描述还不严谨，一局时间太长，新手学习成本高，很难构筑自己想要的体系构建 至于DLC的优点 找不到优点 也许是二次元？反正不是打牌

This game does not feel like a roguelike, won the second game i played which should not happen cos i suck at these games, it is just so easy, i am on my third game and i am running all attackers and i have nearly won lol, i am not even trying, does it get harder i hope so. the skills feel very basic and dont have much variety, there is alot of reading when it comes to finding out what they do so it is overwhelming, the fights themself are just so short, it might feel long as my second run was an hour and a half but i felt like i had just started making my team and then it was over, they really need to balance it to make it harder i feel. in terms of the story i dont really know as i have barely scratched the surface of it but if it is this easy through out, i see no purpose in playing it. To me a roguelike is hard so that when you do win, it feels like an achievement, i just feel like i am playing pokemon level difficulty which just isnt roguelike. edit: didnt win the game with 4 attackers sadly, killed the last boss but his minion survived with 4hp. do not think of this game as a strategy game, think of it as a visual novel that takes alot longer as you have to click lots of buttons

This is an extremely janky waifu-forward Slay the Spire knockoff. Overall it can be fun but it is generally lacking in balance. There are obvious run ruining bugs which is a big downside for a roguelike. Character abilities can stop working in the middle of a run. If a controller disconnects it won't reconnect until the game is restarted AND starting the game on controller disables keyboard input. I'd stay away from this one.

不推荐给希望能娱乐放松的玩家，玩起来实在太累了，感觉不是在玩游戏而是读作文，文本量太大，各种装备，遗物，技能，BUFF五花八门的效果，玩起来真的比任何动作游戏都要累 每遇到一个新BOSS光是机制就得让我读半天，但实际表现效果又有可能跟你理解的不太一样 且这个游戏BOSS数值和机制卡的非常死，无关打牌技术，你build不好就是不可能通关的，熟练难度情况下数值纯恶心人，要么你天胡build，把BOSS几回合之内秒了，要么你就跟BOSS耗去吧，耗个十分钟大概率最后死的还是你，一局的时长实在太长太长了，起码两个小时，从而导致每一次失败挫败感都很强 其中阿扎尔就是最狗屎的狗屎，三个阶段，熟练难度下会用削手牌，加费用，锁技能这种任何卡牌游戏里都恶心的要命的招式，而且这些状态甚至还能共存，伤害更是逆天，砍我方坦克两刀一个，一回合砍三刀，这还不算场上的小怪，如果做不到三回合之内秒一个阶段，你就放弃准备下一把吧 另外手柄支持奇烂的同时还有BUG，不会做能不能别做

The boss fights totally ruin the game, They are the most gimmicky ♥♥♥♥♥♥ aggravating things the devs could come up with. Oh and if you survive the fight, well thats great, now you get to limp the goof troop around trying trying to fight heal before the next boss. G ♥♥♥♥♥♥ G hope you didnt have anything better you could have done for the last 2 ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ hours cuz it meant absolutely nothing.

This was way better than I expected for the price point. If you've played other roguelike deckbuilders before, once you get the hang of some unique mechanics (overload, pain damage, etc.) the game will probably generally be easy in normal mode with the exception of truly terrible RNG and some final fights. The JRPG-like elements are what set it apart from other games I've played in the genre though, and I still found the gameplay loop quite fun. The aesthetics of the game are overall good, and what you see in the storefront video/images is basically what you get. There is still some anime-like fanservice (Miss Chain, Shiranui, etc.) but it wasn't really prominent enough to break immersion or be distracting for me at least. The story is great, and without spoiling much of it is diegetic and draws you in. The only thing I will say is that gameplay-wise, progression into the very last fights is locked behind successfully completing prior runs, so it can hamper your experience if you are not ready for some fairly linear storytelling that needs you to fully complete runs probably somewhere a little over 5 times. Most people will probably be interested enough in the story that this shouldn't be a problem though, unless you are thoroughly skipping through everything. As far as translation quality goes, the game reads and plays perfectly fine in English. Everything sounds natural (this is not crappy Chinese game MTL), and gameplay wording is clear and consistent. If you are a fan of roguelike deckbuilders or JRPGs, I recommend this game if you are willing to try out something that dips into the other genre. If you are a fan of both, I can just recommend it.

there is, at the core of it, a good game here. but boy do i have some things that just annoy me. first of all : controller support. it's pretty bad. navigating the different menus is subpar and even if it works, it's annoying. it's also pretty small. but it ties into a bigger point, the UX! past the UI being... annoying to deal with (controller or not), you have an inventory but also you have a menu you can open to also manipulate your inventory. but also level your characters and micromanage them. except there's no way to just "see" everything at once? or perform operations faster, especially because the UI doesn't feel responsive at times? the game is overly granular in where the information is displayed and how to access it and interact with it and it gets grating really fast. another point that really annoyed me is the presentation. the game feels split in half on this : a lot of effort seemingly went into characters, their designs and even things like cut-in CGs! good portraits! but the sharp contrast with the rest of the game just increases the gap and i could feel it. we go between cool as hell CGs to interacting with semitransparent squares and menus. and it's made even worse because there's a lot of word vomit on display here. game pingpongs between keywords and just paragraphs of texts that while readable and understandable feel clunky to read at times, especially through a UI made to exist and not much past that. i guess a last point of annoyance is the running around maps! ok i guess there's something hidden here or there once in a while but with how many runs you'll end up doing it kind of just feels like a chore because you're going to do everything anyway. if the areas were significantly more different, i'd be more lenient, but they all play the same, and so it does not feel particularly great. but despite all the complaining here, there's some meaty gameplay here. this is a cardbuilder roguelike and even if there's a lot of word vomit, there's a decently big cast of characters on display, all with their unique mechanics that you can interweave with how other characters work. there's some very cool interactions and with the meager amount of hours i've put in i was able to kind of peek behind the curtains and see the potential on display and i can only imagine climbing difficulties and mastering what characters can do, you can get some pretty insane stuff going, and this is without even going into the various mechanics the game will throw at you whether in terms of regular enemies or bosses with a whole mechanic behind them. in the same vein, there's something interesting in the story. a lot of roguelikes will build a world as setdressing and kind of leave it at that and not ask you to think about it, but chrono ark does weave story and gameplay interestingly enough for a roguelike. if you've played any amount of video games, i do not think it's going to floor you, but it's nice to feel like there's an actual *story* going on here. is there more good than bad here for the average person? yeah probably. i tend to be a bit more picky with games and get annoyed easily with some things (especially poor controller support). i do still think it's worth your time, but if you are sick and tired of deckbuilder roguelikes i would still probably avoid it? if you want narrative experiences, there are tons out there that are not tied to deckbuilders that you can enjoy much more leisurely.

Amazing roguelite deck-building game with solid art and graphics, amazing music, and even better gameplay. And the story is actually good and each character involved in the story have their own secrets and playstyles. All the bosses in the game are actually quite challenging and any one of them has the possibility of ending your run, but beating each of the bosses you thought before was impossible before with your newfound synergies and overpowered rng rolls really is satisfying beyond description. If you like card games to begin with, this title is must play. If you don't really like card games, but you like min-maxing/strategizing/puzzle solving, I would still give it a try. If you are not really looking for a complicated or challenging game, then this might not be for you.
